shortDescription: The CAC 40 Index dropped 42 points or 0.51 percent on Thursday to close at 8082 points.Losses were led by Stellantis NV (-3.56%), Societe Generale (-3.54%) and Essilor (-2.83%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Eurofins Scientific SE (2.05%), TotalEnergies SE (2.03%) and AXA (1.18%).

children: The CAC 40 Index dropped 42 points or 0.51 percent on Thursday to close at 8082 points.
Losses were led by Stellantis NV (-3.56%), Societe Generale (-3.54%) and Essilor (-2.83%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Eurofins Scientific SE (2.05%), TotalEnergies SE (2.03%) and AXA (1.18%).

title: The CAC 40 Index Closes 0.51% Lower
